description: This file defines models and logic for managing employee holidays, including holiday statuses, individual holiday records, and related workflows in an Odoo-like system.

classes.name: hr_holidays_status
classes.description: Model representing different types of holiday statuses with color coding and override options.

classes.name: hr_holidays_per_user
classes.description: Model tracking remaining and used holiday days per employee and holiday status.

classes.name: hr_holidays
classes.description: Main model for holiday requests, including creation, validation, cancellation, and constraints.

classes.name: holiday_user_log
classes.description: Model logging actions related to holiday requests.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: strToDate
methods.description: Converts a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format to a date object.

methods.name: _get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves for a user based on validated holiday records.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates new records for holiday per user, assigning user_id from employee.

methods.name: _update_user_holidays
methods.description: Updates holiday counts and notes when a holiday request is validated or canceled.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that holiday date ranges and number of days are consistent.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets holiday request to draft state and recreates holiday records.

methods.name: holidays_validate
methods.description: Validates a holiday request, updates status, and creates associated case.

methods.name: holidays_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a holiday request, sets user, and creates associated case.

methods.name: holidays_refuse
methods.description: Refuses a holiday request, updates status, and sets manager.

methods.name: holidays_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a holiday request, updates status, and updates user holiday counts.

methods.name: holidays_draft
methods.description: Resets a holiday request to draft state.

methods.name: check_holidays
methods.description: Checks if holiday request exceeds available leaves, updates leave counts, and creates cases.

methods.name: _create_holiday
methods.description: Associates holiday records with the holiday user record.

methods.name: onchange_date_to
methods.description: Calculates number of days based on date range input.
